slides.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = (x + 1)^2 - 2$, and the function $g$ is defined by $g(x) = f(x - 4) + 7$. At what value of $x$ does $g$ attain its minimum, and what is that minimum?

slides.title: Shift the vertex, not the formula
slides.body:
For $f(x - c) + d$, the whole graph moves right $c$ and up $d$, so the vertex does too.

Track the horizontal and vertical pieces separately and transformation questions become coordinate arithmetic.
